detailed_description:
The target video is a 15-second Ghibli/Miyazaki-inspired Japanese fairytale healing animation in a bright, sunny forest palette — high brightness, low contrast, medium-high saturation with translucent color; layered vivid greens dominant, supported by clear sky blue and milky white, accented with warm gold, warm orange, and soft pink. Soft diffuse lighting with no hard shadows, airy clear atmosphere, flat hand-drawn texture with delicate color layering. No dialogue anywhere.
[Shot 1] A medium shot from inside the bus carriage establishes <Subject 2>: warm wooden floor, moss-green velvet seats with fine short pile and dark-brown leather edging, and a warm-gold handrail catching the soft daylight. <Subject 1>, the cream-white dumpling creature from <Picture 1> with rounded pear-shaped body, small ears, dot eyes, pink blush, and stubby limbs, laboriously climbs onto a seat — both hands gripping the seat edge, one stubby leg hooking the wall's decorative ridge, its round body wobbling upward bit by bit. Once over the edge it kneels on the seat and catches a small breath. It turns, drags <Subject 3>, the small cloth bundle, from the aisle onto the seat with effort, carries it in both arms to the window side, and sits down beside it with hands neatly on its knees. It tilts its head toward the window — outside, the station sign begins sliding backward as the bus starts; <Subject 1> sways slightly with inertia, its dot eyes widening a little. The camera holds a steady medium frame with only a very slight drift.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a close-up from a rear-side angle. <Subject 1> now kneels on the seat, both paws gripping the window sill, its round face nearly pressed to the glass, small nose flattened into a tiny oval. Its breath fogs a faint patch on the glass that quickly fades away. Its wide dot eyes reflect fast-moving colorful blurs outside; its mouth is slightly open, fully absorbed in the view. One paw still clutches <Subject 4>, the bus ticket, its corner slightly crumpled by palm warmth. Sunlight pours through the window, rimming its milky fluff with a soft, almost translucent glow. The camera stays nearly static with a gentle micro-drift.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the view shifts to a subjective window POV with a steady horizontal traveling motion matching the bus's speed. <Subject 5> unfolds as a flowing summer panorama: in the foreground, multi-gradient green grass waves streak backward as blurred lines, interspersed with flashes of bright-yellow wildflowers and soft-pink vetch; in the midground, rolling emerald hills drift slowly past, with a brief glimpse of a small blue pond mirroring the milky-white clouds above; in the background, a field of warm-gold sunflowers lingers in the upper right for several seconds before gently exiting the frame. The sky is a clear sky-blue with large milky-white cumulus clouds whose bases seem to run alongside the bus. Faint window-frame shadows slide across the view and slip away. The lateral motion remains smooth and even through the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
A soft bus engine hum continues throughout, joined in [Shot 1] by the faint rustle of the cloth bundle being dragged across the seat, and in [Shot 3] by the muffled whoosh of wind passing the windows. All diegetic sound stays gentle and unobtrusive.

non_diegetic_music:
A gentle, warm Ghibli-style acoustic/orchestral healing cue — soft strings with light woodwind and celesta — at an unhurried tempo, subtly brightening with the bus's departure and the dumpling's sense of wonder, with no dramatic swell.
